rca_of_the_issue: Salary & Interview tab bug RCA: (1) Reproduction: login as admin, navigate /job-search -> tab 7 (Salary & Interview), fill inputs, click Benchmark salary or Interview questions -> shows error 'unavailable right now'. (2) Direct verification via curl: POST /api/jobs/ai/salary-benchmark and POST /api/jobs/ai/interview-sim both return HTTP 410 with detail 'Legacy /api/jobs write endpoint is permanently retired'. (3) Root cause: /app/backend/server.py:580-589 defines FEATURE26_LEGACY_WRITE_PREFIXES containing '/api/jobs' (coarse startswith match). Middleware at :778-798 rejects any POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to any path starting with '/api/jobs'. The router in /app/backend/routes/job_ai_services.py:14 uses prefix '/jobs/ai' which under the '/api' app router becomes '/api/jobs/ai/*' — swept up by the retirement gate. (4) Mitigation options: A) rename router prefix to '/job-search/ai' in job_ai_services.py:14 and update frontend api.post calls in SalaryInterviewTab.tsx:56,77 (recommended - keeps semantic separation); B) add explicit allowlist check in the middleware: if path.startswith('/api/jobs/ai/'): return await call_next(request) BEFORE the retire prefix check.
